subject.title: feat(repair): import clusters from Gitcrawl cloud

question: After the crawl-remote prerequisites deploy, does the protected-main cloud/parity run prove the OIDC restrictions and repair-intake behavior strongly enough to approve this workflow trust-boundary expansion?
rationale: Tests can validate parsing and fail-closed contracts, but only the protected workflow and deployed crawl-remote service can establish the real issuer, subject, audience, reader scope, expiry, and publication behavior.

options.title: Keep Draft Until Live Proof
options.body: Deploy the prerequisites and require redacted protected-main cloud and parity evidence before marking the PR ready or merging it.

options.title: Approve Local-Only Landing
options.body: Land only the adapter-backed local importer and defer OIDC permissions and cloud/parity activation to a separately proven PR.

options.title: Accept Staged Remote Risk
options.body: Merge with `local` still default and explicitly accept that cloud/parity remain unapproved until later protected-main validation.

recommendation.title: Keep Draft Until Live Proof
recommendation.body: Deploy the prerequisites and require redacted protected-main cloud and parity evidence before marking the PR ready or merging it.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice concerns protected repair-workflow permissions and rollout rather than a mechanical code defect, and current-main repair-lane history points to this person as the closest decision owner.
